overview: The 2026 manual adds many entirely new topics worth reviewing, including the choice between REAL ID and Standard cards, the hands-free mobile device law and stricter rules for drivers under 18, modern technology like Advanced Driver Assistance Systems and roundabouts, and a wide range of bicyclist and pedestrian protections such as the Vulnerable Road Users four-foot passing rule, bike lanes, sharrows, the Dutch Reach, and new signals like the flashing yellow arrow and pedestrian hybrid beacon. Junior operator requirements have become more demanding, with more behind-the-wheel and supervised driving hours, parental participation, tougher curfew and passenger penalties, and a 14-day waiting period after a failed road test. Drivers should also note updated fees, fines, and surcharges, stricter OUI and chemical-test-refusal penalties, the move-over law, snow-and-ice removal rules, the 3-second following distance, and new child restraint criteria. Finally, the edition introduces practical guidance on drowsy driving, car safety kits, breakdown procedures, tunnel safety, three-point turns, proper backing-up technique, and green driving tips.

sections.title: REAL ID and Standard Massachusetts Cards
sections.description: The 2026 edition introduces a choice between REAL ID and Standard Massachusetts license/ID cards, which did not exist in 2003.
bullets: "A REAL ID Card issued by Massachusetts is compliant with the federal REAL ID Act of 2005. This type of license or ID Card can be used to access certain federal facilities and to board flights within the United States." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Facial Image Policy
sections.description: The 2026 edition adds a detailed Facial Image Policy specifying restrictions on facial coverings, eyeglasses, hats, and tattoos for photo-image capture.
bullets: "A solid or transparent facial cover (scarf, veil, eyeglasses/sunglasses, goggles, surgical or dust mask, etc.) is not acceptable. Eyeglasses, including reading or prescription glasses, are not allowed, even if the applicant normally wears them." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Junior Operator Curfew Hours
sections.description: The 2003 manual set the Junior Operator night driving restriction at 12:00 a.m. to 5:00 a.m.; the 2026 edition changes the start time to 12:30 a.m.
bullets: "As the holder of a JOL, you may not operate a motor vehicle between 12:30 a.m. and 5:00 a.m. unless you are accompanied by one of your parents or your legal guardian." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Junior Operator Restriction Suspension Periods
sections.description: The 2003 manual imposed suspensions of 30/60/90 days for passenger restriction violations; the 2026 edition increases these to 60 days/180 days/one year and adds a retraining requirement.
bullets: "If you violate the passenger restriction or the night restriction, you will be subject to a license suspension of 60 days for a first offense, 180 days for a second offense, and one year for subsequent offenses. For a second or subsequent offense, you will also be required to complete a Driver Attitudinal Retraining course." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Junior Operator Driver Education In-Car Hours
sections.description: The 2003 manual required 6 hours of in-car behind-the-wheel training; the 2026 edition requires 12 hours.
bullets: "Successfully complete an RMV-approved driver education and training program, which includes 30 hours of classroom instruction; 12 hours of in-car, behind-the-wheel training; and six hours of in-car experience observing other student drivers." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Junior Operator Supervised Driving Hours
sections.description: The 2003 manual required an additional 12 hours of supervised driving; the 2026 edition requires 40 hours (or 30 with a driver skills development program).
bullets: "Complete at least an additional 40 hours of supervised, behind-the-wheel driving as shown by a certified statement provided by a parent or guardian. The RMV will accept 30 hours of driving supervised by a parent or guardian if the applicant completed a driver skills development program." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"you must log an additional 40 hours of supervised driving (30 hours if you completed a driver skills development program)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Parent/Guardian Driver Education Instruction
sections.description: The 2026 edition adds a new requirement that a parent or guardian participate in two hours of driver's education instruction.
bullets: "A parent or guardian must participate in two hours of instruction on the driver’s education curriculum (unless they have participated within the past five years)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Junior Operator Drag Racing and Speeding Penalties
sections.description: The 2026 edition specifies updated suspension periods for drag racing and speeding offenses that differ from the 2003 second/third-offense structure.
bullets: "You will face additional suspension periods of one year for a first drag racing offense and three years for a subsequent offense. For a first speeding offense, you will be suspended for 90 days; for a subsequent offense, you will be suspended for one year." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Junior Operator Mobile Device Prohibition
sections.description: The 2026 edition prohibits drivers under 18 from using any mobile electronic device while driving, a restriction absent from the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Drivers under 18 may not use any mobile electronic device for any reason while operating a motor vehicle. The only exception is for reporting an emergency." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: State-to-State License Verification Program
sections.description: The 2026 edition adds the State-to-State program that cancels licenses/IDs issued by other participating states, which did not exist in 2003.
bullets: "Massachusetts is part of the State-to-State program, which checks valid driver licenses and state issued ID cards issued by other participating states." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Out-of-Country Driving Violation Penalty
sections.description: The 2026 edition specifies a criminal penalty and $500 fine for violations of Section 10 governing out-of-country licensed drivers, not present in 2003.
bullets: "A violation of Section 10 is a criminal violation and a first offense is subject to a fine of $500." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Expanded List of License Restrictions
sections.description: The 2026 edition adds a comprehensive coded list of license restrictions (including ignition interlock, bioptic telescoping lens, CDL-specific restrictions) far beyond the few medical/junior restrictions described in 2003.
bullets: "T Ignition Interlock U 3 Wheeled Motorcycle V Medical Variance W Intrastate Medical Waiver X CDL - No Cargo in CMV Tanker" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Learner's Permit Exam Length and Passing Score
sections.description: The number of exam questions, passing requirements, and time limit have increased compared to the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Each learner’s permit exam has 25 multiple-choice questions." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"To pass the exam, you must answer 18 questions correctly within the allotted time of 25 minutes." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Supervised Driving Hours for Driver's Education
sections.description: The required supervised driving hours increased from 12 hours in 2003 to 40 hours (or 30 with a skills development program), and a new parental participation requirement was added.
bullets: "You must also complete 40 hours of supervised driving (30 hours if you completed a driver skills development program), and your parent or guardian must participate in two hours of the driver’s education curriculum (unless he/she already attended in the past five years)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Out-of-State Vehicle Insurance Minimum Limits for Road Test
sections.description: The minimum insurance coverage limits required for an out-of-state test vehicle increased from $20,000/$40,000/$5,000 to $25,000/$50,000/$30,000.
bullets: "you must show the examiner proof of insurance coverage equal to Massachusetts minimum limits, which are $25,000/$50,000 for bodily injury and $30,000 for property damage." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Cancellation/Reschedule Notice Period
sections.description: The notice period for canceling or rescheduling a road test without a fee increased from 24 hours in 2003 to 72 hours.
bullets: "There is no additional fee if you cancel or reschedule with more than 72 hours notice." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"are rejected by the examiner, or cancel your appointment with less than 72 hours notice, you will still be charged the $35 fee" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Mandatory Waiting Period After Failed Road Test
sections.description: A new 14-day waiting period is required before retaking a road test after failing or not appearing, which was not in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "If you fail a road test or do not appear for your scheduled test, you must wait at least 14 days before taking another test." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Rejected Road Tests Criteria
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces specific criteria allowing examiners to reject road tests for signs of impairment, odors, or unsupervised children/animals, which was not present in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "An odor of alcohol or cannabis is coming from you or your sponsor, including from clothing or inside the vehicle" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Minor children, babies, or animals are present in the vehicle and cannot be left unsupervised at the Service Center. Trained service animals are allowed in the vehicle, but emotional support animals are not." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Parking Brake Requirement and Testing Procedure
sections.description: The 2026 manual requires a parking brake (manual or electric) for emergency stops and specifies a regulatory testing procedure, replacing the 2003 manual's acceptance of a foot brake or emergency hand brake.
bullets: "An accessible parking brake so the examiner can make an emergency stop. The parking brake can be manual or electric (push or pull button)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Massachusetts regulation 540 CMR 4.04 (4) requires that parking brakes be tested by accelerating the motor to 1,200 to 1,300 RPMs with the vehicle in the lowest gear." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Prohibition of Donut Spare Tire for Road Test
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new prohibition against using a vehicle with a limited-use spare tire for a road test.
bullets: "A vehicle cannot be used for a road test if one of its tires has been replaced by a "donut" (limited use spare) tire." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Repair and Dealer Plate Restrictions for Road Test
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds new rules prohibiting or restricting use of vehicles with dealer, farm, or repair plates for road tests.
bullets: "You will not be allowed to take a road test in a vehicle with a repair plate." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Specialized Vehicle Features and Mechanical/Software Aid Restriction
sections.description: The 2026 manual addresses modern specialized features (back-up cameras, automatic parallel parking, GPS) and a new mechanical/software aid restriction, which did not exist in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "If adaptive equipment for a legitimate medical condition is installed in the vehicle and necessary for operation, or if you need to use specialized features, a “mechanical/software aid” restriction will be added to a license." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Additional Documentation Required with SSN Denial Notice
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands the documentation required when presenting an SSN Denial Notice, adding visa status, I-94 record, and passport requirements, and introduces a No Social Security Number Affidavit option.
bullets: "If you have applied for an SSN with the SSA and been denied, you must present the written Denial Notice (not more than 60 days old) the SSA provided you and all of the following: • Proof of your current visa status • An I-94 Record of Arrival & Departure...• Your current non-U.S. Passport" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"If you do not have an SSN and cannot apply for one, you can present a No Social Security Number Affidavit and apply for a Standard Driver's License" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Testing Accommodations for Disabilities
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces formal reasonable accommodation procedures including extended time and a designated reader, replacing the more limited 2003 special examination provisions.
bullets: "If you have a cognitive or physical disability that would prevent you from taking a standard exam, you may request a reasonable accommodation, which could include: • Extended time • Reader - A designated RMV employee reads the exam questions aloud to you" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Limit on Number of Road Test Sponsorships
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new limit on how many applicants a single operator may sponsor within a one-year period.
bullets: "Operators are not allowed to sponsor more than three different applicants within a one year period without approval from the RMV Road Test Program." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Class M License Requirement for Under-18 Applicants
sections.description: The 2026 manual states that applicants under 18 are not eligible for an RMV Class M road test and must complete the MREP basic rider course, which was not specified in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "If you are under 18 years old, you are not eligible for an RMV Class M road test and must complete the MREP basic rider course to get a Class M license." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Fee
sections.description: The road test application fee increased from $20 to $35.
bullets: "The RMV charges a flat fee for any license application. This fee covers the cost of processing your application and scheduling a road test." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"you will still be charged the $35 fee, which must be paid prior to a new test being booked" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Temporary License Validity Period
sections.description: The temporary license period after passing the road test increased from 30 days to 60 days.
bullets: "the examiner will validate your learner's permit and it will become a temporary license, valid up to 60 days (unless the permit expires before that)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Issue/Renewal Fee
sections.description: The Class D and Class M license fee increased to $50 each (Class M was previously an additional $15 to add).
bullets: "License issue/renew fee - Class D - $50.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"License issue/renew fee - Class M - $50.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Out-of-State Conversion Fees
sections.description: Specific out-of-state license conversion fees are now listed.
bullets: "Class D* - $115.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"*To add motorcycle privileges (Class M) to any of these license classes, you must pay an additional $3.00 per year." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Child Passenger Restraint Requirements
sections.description: The criteria for child passenger restraints changed from age 5 and 40 pounds to age eight or fifty-seven inches tall.
bullets: "Infants and small children must sit in federally approved child passenger restraints until they... 1. Are at least eight years old or 2. At least fifty-seven inches tall" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Service Animals During Road Test
sections.description: New provision allows trained service animals but not emotional support animals in the vehicle during a road test.
bullets: "Trained service animals are allowed in the vehicle, but emotional support animals are not." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Deaf and Hard of Hearing Road Tests
sections.description: New section details the process for scheduling road tests with interpreter services for deaf or hard of hearing applicants.
bullets: "If you are deaf or hard of hearing, you can schedule a road test by calling 1-877-RMV-TTDD (1-877-768-8833)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Veteran's Indicator on License
sections.description: New option to have the word 'Veteran' printed on a license or ID card for honorably discharged veterans.
bullets: "If you are a veteran of the U.S. Armed Forces and were honorably discharged, you can choose to have the word \"Veteran\" printed on your license or ID card." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Organ and Tissue Donor Registration Fund
sections.description: A $2 contribution to the Organ and Tissue Donor Registration Fund is now added to renewal or duplicate fees.
bullets: "to the Organ and Tissue Donor Registration Fund . This $2 will be added to the renewal or duplicate fee ." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Emergency Lights Restriction
sections.description: New restriction prohibits emergency lights on a vehicle without an RMV permit.
bullets: "Emergency lights (flashing, rotating, oscillating, or strobe lights) are not allowed on a vehicle unless you get a permit from the RMV." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Car Safety Kits
sections.description: New section recommends specific safety items to carry in a vehicle.
bullets: "It is recommended to carry the following items in your vehicle: • Reflective Safety Vest • Reflective Warning Triangles or LED Flares • First Aid Kit • Glass Breaker Tool" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Loud Noise Inside Vehicle
sections.description: New provision advises avoiding loud noise levels so emergency vehicle sirens can be heard.
bullets: "Avoid loud noise levels in your vehicle so you can hear emergency vehicle sirens." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Headphones Earplug Exception
sections.description: The headphone prohibition now includes an exception allowing one earplug for cell phone use for drivers 18 or older.
bullets: "If you are 18 or older, you can use one earplug for use with a cell phone." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Permit Conversion REAL ID Expiration
sections.description: Converted permits now may expire at the end of an authorized stay in the U.S. for REAL ID applicants.
bullets: "The Massachusetts issued permit will expire two years from the adjusted issue date or, for REAL ID applicants, at the end of your authorized stay in the U.S. (whichever comes first)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Hands-Free Mobile Electronic Device Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual prohibits the use of hand-held mobile electronic devices while driving, whereas the 2003 manual explicitly permitted cellular phone use with one hand on the wheel.
bullets: "The use of hand-held mobile electronic devices (including cell phones) while driving is prohibited in Massachusetts (Chapter 90, Section 13B and Chapter 122 of the Acts of 2019)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers 18 and older can only use mobile electronic devices in “hands­free” mode while driving." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Penalties for Hand-Held Device Use
sections.description: The 2026 manual establishes specific escalating fines and penalties for using a hand-held mobile electronic device while driving.
bullets: "1st offense - $100 fine" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"2nd offense - $250 fine, plus mandatory completion of a distracted driving educational program" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"3rd and subsequent offenses - $500 fine, plus insurance surcharge and mandatory completion of a distracted driving program" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Device Use Ban for Drivers Under 18
sections.description: The 2026 manual prohibits drivers under 18 from using any mobile electronic device for any reason while driving except to report an emergency.
bullets: "Drivers under 18 cannot use any mobile electronic device for any reason while driving. The only exception is for reporting an emergency." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Following Distance Rule
sections.description: The safe following distance rule changed from a 2-second rule in the 2003 manual to a 3-second rule in the 2026 manual.
bullets: "Use the "three-second" rule to keep a safe distance from the vehicle in front of you." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Keep more space (at least four seconds) behind a motorcycle than you would for another vehicle." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Keep more space (at least ten seconds) between your vehicle and heavy equipment (for example, dump trucks, tractors)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Tailgating Fine
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies a fine for tailgating that was not stated in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "The fine for tailgating can be as high as $100." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Vulnerable Road Users Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces a Vulnerable Road Users Law requiring a minimum four-foot passing distance, which does not exist in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "When you pass a vulnerable road user, you must leave a safe passing distance of at least four feet between your vehicle and the road user." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new topic on Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), which does not appear in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Many cars and trucks now come with Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS). These can make driving safer, but only if used correctly." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Drowsy Driving
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a dedicated drowsy driving section with statistics and guidance not present in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Driving while tired or drowsy can be deadly. 633 people died in 2020 from drowsy driving related crashes" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"The ONLY true way to protect yourself from drowsy driving is to get enough sleep and to not drive when you feel tired." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Plate Visibility Requirement
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a specific requirement that the plate number be visible from 60 feet at night, which is not stated in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "You must keep your license plates clean and they cannot be blocked by anything. Your plate number must be visible from 60 feet at night." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Headlight Use Requirements
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands the conditions under which headlights and taillights are required, including tunnels and a 500-foot visibility standard.
bullets: "When you cannot clearly see people or vehicles 500 feet ahead due to insufficient light or weather conditions" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"While driving through a tunnel" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Snow and Ice Removal Requirement
sections.description: The 2026 manual requires removing all ice and snow including from the roof, hood, and trunk, with a negligent operation charge for failure, which is not in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "It is very important that you clear the roof, hood, and trunk so ice and snow does not blow into vehicles behind you. If you do not, you can be charged with negligent operation." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Tire Tread Penny Test
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the penny test method for checking tire tread depth, which was not described in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "is to slide a penny into a tread groove . If you can see the top of Lincoln’s head, your tires are worn out ." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Motorized Scooter Safety
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds rules for motorized scooters, a category not addressed in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "A motorized scooter is any two or three-wheeled vehicle with handlebars and an electric or gas motor that can move the vehicle with or without human propulsion." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Do not drive faster than 20 mph." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Limited Use Vehicle Safety
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new vehicle category for limited use vehicles not present in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "A limited use vehicle can have two or more wheels. It can go faster than 30 mph, but not more than 40 mph." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Low Speed Vehicle Safety
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds rules for low speed vehicles, a category not present in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "A Low Speed Vehicle (LSV) has four wheels and can only go between 20 and 25 mph. It must have a gross weight rating lower than 3,000 lbs." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Civil Motor Vehicle Infraction Fees and Surcharges
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a $5 public safety surcharge to CMVI fines and a $25 hearing filing fee not present in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Every fine for a CMVI that comes from Chapter 89 or 90 of the Massachusetts General Laws will have an added $5 public safety surcharge." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"If you request a hearing, you must pay a $25 filing fee to the RMV." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Speeding Violation Public Safety Surcharge
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a $5 public safety surcharge to speeding violations, raising the example fine from $180 to $185.
bullets: "The lowest penalty for driving above the speed limit is a $100 fine, plus an additional $5 public safety surcharge which is added to all speeding violations." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driver Retraining Course Threshold
sections.description: The 2026 manual lowers the threshold for mandatory Driver Retraining from five surchargeable events to three within a two-year period.
bullets: "If you get three or more surchargeable events on your driving record within a two-year period, you must complete the Massachusetts Driver Retraining Course." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: At-Fault Crash Claim Threshold
sections.description: The 2026 manual raises the at-fault crash claim payment threshold from more than $500 to more than $1000.
bullets: "Has paid more than $1000 for collision, limited collision, or damage to someone else’s property or has paid more than $1000 for bodily injury" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Safety Laws
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands bicycle safety laws to allow officers to cite bicyclists and motorists and to require rental companies to offer helmets.
bullets: "If a police officer sees a bicyclist commit a traffic violation, the officer can issue a citation the same way they would for a motorist." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Companies that rent bicycles must offer helmets that meet all safety requirements for renters." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Fake ID License Suspension
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds fake ID offenses as a discretionary reason for license suspension in the reasons for suspension section.
bullets: "Even if you are not convicted, the RMV can suspend your driving privileges for six months (or one year after a conviction) for the following offenses" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Ignition Interlock Devices
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a requirement for Ignition Interlock Devices for repeat OUI offenders, which does not appear in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "If you had two or more operating under the influence offenses and are eligible for a hardship license or for license reinstatement, you must have an Ignition Interlock Device. It must be attached to your motor vehicle at your expense." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Use of a Mobile Electronic Device
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds suspension periods and penalties for convictions related to use of a mobile electronic device, absent from the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Conviction for the Use of a Mobile Electronic Device (text or phone) (c. 90, §8M) 60 days— first offense 180 days— second offense One year— subsequent offenses First offense requires a $100 fine, a new learner’s permit exam, a Driver Attitudinal Retraining Course, and a new road test." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Negligent Operation and Injury from Mobile Phone Use
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a criminal offense and suspension for negligent operation and injury from mobile phone use, not present in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Conviction for Negligent Operation and Injury from Mobile Phone Use (c. 90, §24) 180 days— first offense One year— second or subsequent offense" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Vehicular Manslaughter Suspension
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a vehicular manslaughter offense with a 15 years to lifetime suspension, absent from the 2003 manual's criminal offense table.
bullets: "Vehicular manslaughter 15 years–Lifetime $500" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Defacing Property / Graffiti Suspension
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a license suspension for defacing property or applying graffiti, not present in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Defacing real or personal property, spraying paint or applying stickers or other graffiti (Operation of a ve­ hicle is not required) One year (or delay of one year in obtaining a License) $100" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Other Reasons for License Suspension
sections.description: The 2026 manual lists additional non-driving reasons for license suspension such as failure to register as a sex offender, drug trafficking convictions, unpaid income tax, and bad payments, which are not enumerated in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Have failed to register as a sex offender" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Have made a bad payment to the RMV (for example, you paid with a check that was later rejected or you paid with a credit card and later canceled the payment with the bank)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: OUI Penalties
sections.description: The 2026 manual changes OUI penalties by adding minimum fine amounts and mandatory minimum jail terms not present in the 2003 manual's penalty table.
bullets: "First Offense $500–$5,000 Maximum 2 1/2 years One Year" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Second Offense $600–$10,000 Minimum 30 days Maximum 2 1/2 years Two years" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Suspension Periods for Refusing a Chemical Test
sections.description: The 2026 manual provides detailed and longer suspension periods for chemical test refusals based on prior offenses, replacing the 2003 manual's simpler refusal provisions.
bullets: "Drivers over age 21 No Prior OUI Offenses 180 days One Prior OUI Offense Three years Two Prior OUI Offenses Five years Three or More Prior OUI Offenses Lifetime" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Drag Racing Suspension for Drivers Over 18
sections.description: The 2026 criminal offenses table adds a specific drag racing suspension and fine for drivers over 18, not in the 2003 manual's criminal table.
bullets: "Drag racing (by drivers over the age of 18) 30 days-180 days $500 - $1,000" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Nonrenewal for Toll Violations
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands reasons for nonrenewal to include unpaid Massachusetts, Maine, or New Hampshire E-ZPass/Fast Lane and Tobin Bridge toll violations, beyond the 2003 manual's Fast Lane mention.
bullets: "Unpaid Massachusetts, Maine, or New Hampshire E-ZPass/Fast Lane toll violations" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Unpaid Tobin Bridge violations" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Dangers of Speeding to Pedestrians
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds specific statistics on the danger of vehicle speed to pedestrians, which do not appear in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "At a speed of 20 mph, 13% of pedestrians are seriously injured or killed in a crash. At 30 mph, that increases to 40% and at 40 mph it increases to 73%." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Thickly Settled District 25 mph Speed Limit
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds that some communities have a thickly settled speed limit of 25 mph, a provision not present in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Some communities have a thickly settled speed limit of 25 mph unless posted otherwise (per M.G.L. c90, Section 17c). Signs are posted at all entrances to these cities and towns." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Boston Harbor Tunnel Minimum Speed
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a minimum speed of 20 mph in the Boston Harbor tunnels, which is not in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "There is a minimum speed of 20 mph in the Boston Harbor tunnels (Callahan, Sumner, and Ted Williams)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Alcohol and Marijuana Combined Crash Risk
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds specific crash risk multipliers for alcohol and combined alcohol-marijuana use, absent from the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Alchohol use makes the risk of a crash five times more likely. Alcohol use combined with marijuana use makes the risk of a crash twelve times more likely." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Flashing Yellow Arrow Signal
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces the flashing yellow arrow signal, which did not exist in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "A flashing yellow arrow allows you to turn left or right in the direction of the arrow when oncoming traffic has a green light but there is a break in traffic." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon, a pedestrian-activated device not in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons are activated by pedestrians manually by a push button or by a pedestrian detection system." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You must stop for pedestrians when the beacon is flashing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon with its multi-state signal operation, not present in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "A Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB) allows pedestrians to safely cross a roadway. A PHB only operates when activated by a pedestrian." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Signals
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces bicycle-specific traffic signals not in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Bicycle signals are lights specifically meant for bicyclists. They display as steady red, yellow, and green bicycle symbols." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Yielding to Pedestrians When Turning into Driveway or Parking Lot
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds an explicit driver rule to yield to pedestrians when turning into a driveway or parking lot.
bullets: "You must yield to pedestrians when turning into a driveway or parking lot." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Shared Lane Markings (Sharrows)
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces Shared Lane Markings (Sharrows) for bicyclists, not present in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Shared Lane Markings (also known as Sharrows) help bicyclists position themselves in the right location and in the right direction in a lane that is shared with motor vehicles." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Lanes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a description of marked bicycle lanes and rules for crossing them, not in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Bicycle lanes are portions of the roadway that are intended for use by bicyclists and are typically marked by solid white lines, along with pavement markings and signs. They are five feet wide." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Advisory Bicycle Lanes
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces advisory bicycle lanes, not present in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Advisory bicycle lanes are becoming common on streets that are too narrow for a full bicycle lane, but still have a lot of bicycle traffic." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Green Pavement
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds green pavement markings for areas with potential bicycle/vehicle conflict, not in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Green pavement is used in areas where there could be road sharing conflicts between motor vehicles and bicycles." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bus Lanes (Red Pavement)
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds red pavement markings for public transit lanes, not in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Red pavement is used for travel lanes or station stops used by public transit systems." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Yield Lines
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds yield lines as a pavement marking, which were not described in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "An intersection with a yield sign may have a YIELD line painted across it. A YIELD line looks like a series of triangles painted next to each other." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Channelizing Islands
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces channelizing islands and prohibits driving over or parking on them, not in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "You cannot drive over or park a motor vehicle upon any channelizing island, unless directed to do so by a police officer." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Crossing Guards
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a dedicated section on crossing guards and driver awareness, not present in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "As a driver, you should look for warning signs that crossing guards and children may be in the road and be prepared to stop." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Three-Point Turns
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a detailed procedure for three-point turns not present in the 2003 edition.
bullets: "When there is not enough room for a U-turn, you may consider a three- point turn. This will put you in the opposite direction." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Backing Up
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a step-by-step backing up procedure not found in the 2003 edition.
bullets: "Shift into reverse and start backing up, while looking over your right shoulder. Ensure a safe and smooth speed while maintaning your lane." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Roundabouts
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces roundabouts as a distinct topic, which is not addressed in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Roundabouts are similar to rotaries. They are generally much smaller than rotaries and have a smaller central barrier." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Courtesy Crashes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds guidance on avoiding 'courtesy crashes' caused by waving drivers through traffic.
bullets: "Waving people in through stopped traffic, or driving through traffic when someone waves you in, creates a dangerous situation and can easily result in a crash." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Move-Over Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the move-over law requiring drivers to change lanes or slow for stationary emergency vehicles.
bullets: "The “move-over law” (Chapter 418 of the Acts of 2008) requires that if you are approaching a stationary emergency vehicle and it is displaying its flashing lights, you must proceed with caution and reduce your speed to that of a reasonable and safe speed for the road conditions." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Passing Stopped Vehicles
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a specific rule about not passing stopped or turning vehicles.
bullets: "Do not pass vehicles that are stopped or are turning (both at intersections and at non-intersections). They may be stopped for another vehicle, a person, or an animal that you cannot see." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: School Bus Violation Penalty
sections.description: The fine for a first school bus passing violation increased from up to $200 to $250.
bullets: "A first violation of this law can cause a license suspension and a $250 fine." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Reporting Aggressive Drivers
sections.description: The number to report aggressive or dangerous drivers changed from State Police at *77 to 911.
bullets: "If you have a cell phone, call the State Policeat 911 to report an emergency situation." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Funeral Processions
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands funeral procession rules with a legal definition, statutory citation, and right-of-way provisions not in the 2003 edition.
bullets: "Funeral processions have the right-of-way at intersections, with the EXCEPTION that they must yield to emergency vehicles with flashing lights or sirens or when directed by law enforcement." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driving in a Funeral Procession
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds detailed rules for drivers who are part of, or encountering, a funeral procession.
bullets: "Not drive faster than 55 MPH on a highway with a speed limit of 55 MPH or higher. You must also not go more than 5 MPH slower than the speed limit on any other public way." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"You may not drive between procession vehicles unless directed by law enforcement or you are operating an emergency vehicle with siren and flashing lights turned on." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Work Zone Speeding Fine
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds that speeding fines are doubled in a work area.
bullets: "If you are cited for speeding in a “work area”, the fine will be doubled ." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Parking in a Bus Stop Fine
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies a $100 penalty for parking in a posted bus stop, which was not stated in 2003.
bullets: "In a bus stop (the penalty for parking in a posted bus stop is $100)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: HP-DV Parking Fines
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds specific dollar fines for disabled-parking violations not stated in 2003.
bullets: "The fine for a first offense is $300. The fine for wrongful use of a disabled person or veteran plate or placard is a minimum of $500." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: No Parking in a Bicycle Lane
sections.description: The 2026 manual prohibits parking in a bicycle lane and in striped crosshatch areas next to HP-DV spaces.
bullets: "In a bicycle lane" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"In a striped crosshatch area next to an HP-DV space, even if you have disability plates or a placard" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: No Parking on the Massachusetts Turnpike
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a parking prohibition on the Massachusetts Turnpike with a stated fine range.
bullets: "On the Massachusetts Turnpike (fines range from $15 - $100)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Move-Over Law for Stationary Emergency Vehicles
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces the 'move-over law' requiring drivers to change lanes or slow down for stopped emergency and maintenance vehicles.
bullets: "The “move-over law” (Chapter 418 of the Acts of 2008) requires you to be cautious and reduce your speed to a speed that is reasonable and safe for the road conditions when you approach a stationary emergency vehicle with flashing lights." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"On a highway with at least four lanes (at least two in the same direction you are heading), yield the right-of way by safely “moving over” to a lane that is not next to the lane the emergency vehicle is in." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Expanded Bicyclist Laws
sections.description: The 2026 manual significantly expands bicyclist rules with amended statutory provisions including full lane use, signaling exceptions, side-by-side riding, and helmet requirements.
bullets: "You can use the full lane anywhere, anytime, and on any street (except limited access or express state highways where signs specifically prohibiting bicycles have been posted), even if there is a bike lane." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"A bicycle helmet approved by the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission must be worn by a bicycle operator or passenger under 16 years old." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"You must report any crash involving personal injury and any crash involving property damage in excess of $100 to the police in the municipality where it occurred." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Motorist Rules in the Presence of Bicycles
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds specific statutory rules for motorists passing, turning, and opening doors near bicycles.
bullets: "You must stay at least four feet away when passing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers and passengers can be fined up to $100 for opening a vehicle door into an oncoming bicycle." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Boxes
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces bicycle boxes, a pavement marking and traffic control feature not present in 2003.
bullets: "Bicycle boxes are pavement markings that are installed at intersections to allow bicyclists a safe way to turn when approaching a red light." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers must stop behind the bicycle box (even when it's empty) and wait for a green light." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Separated Bicycle Lanes
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces separated bicycle lanes (cycle tracks/protected bike lanes) and associated driver rules.
bullets: "Separated bicycle lanes, also know as cycle tracks and protected bike lanes, physically separate bicycle traffic from vehicular traffic." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers must always check for oncoming bicyclists when turning across a bike lane." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Dutch Reach Door-Opening Method
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the 'Dutch Reach' method for opening vehicle doors to protect bicyclists.
bullets: "Open the door with your far hand (the hand farther from the door). This is called the "Dutch Reach" method because it originated in the Netherlands." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Leaving the Scene of a Crash Penalties
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds specific criminal penalties for leaving the scene of a crash, which were not detailed in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Up to $5000 and imprisonment of up to 2 ½ years in jail or up to 10 years in state prison for leaving the scene after a crash causing personal injury to any person that resulted in death (Section 2 (a ½) (2))" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driving Through Tunnels
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section with safety tips for driving through tunnels, including what to do in crashes, fires, and heavy traffic.
bullets: "Hazardous Materials are prohibited, including propane." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Green Driving Tips
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section on fuel-saving and environmental driving tips not present in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "Fuel consumption increases about five percent for every five miles per hour driven above 60 mph." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Idling gets you zero miles per gallon. So when you’re stopped, switch off the engine. It saves you fuel, and it’s the law – Massachusetts state law prohibits idling for more than five minutes." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Breakdown Safety Equipment Procedures
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds detailed procedures for safety vests and placement of warning triangles or LED flares during a breakdown, which were not specified in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "If you stop on a two-lane road carrying traffic in both directions or on an undivided highway, place your warning triangles or LED flares: 10 feet behind your vehicle 100 feet behind your vehicle 100 feet in front of your vehicle" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driver Removal Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual references the Driver Removal Law requiring vehicles to be moved out of travel lanes when there are no injuries, not present in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "If there are no injuries, the Driver Removal Law requires that vehicles be moved out of travel lanes to a safe location." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Fine for Failure to Produce License or Registration
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies a $35 fine for first offense failure to produce license or registration, not stated in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "There is a $35 fine for a first offense for the failure to produce either document." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Stalling on Railroad Tracks - Emergency Notification
sections.description: The 2026 manual updates the railroad stall procedure to direct drivers to call the Emergency Notification System (ENS) number on the crossbuck, whereas the 2003 manual directed calling the police.
bullets: "If you cannot move your vehicle from the tracks, call the toll free Emergency Notification System (ENS) number that is located in the middle of the crossbuck or on the metal box near the grade crossing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Penalty for Failure to File Crash Report
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds that failure to file a required crash report can result in fines and license suspension, not specified in the 2003 manual.
bullets: "If you are required to file a crash report, but you do not, you can be fined and your license can be suspended or revoked." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Salvage Repairable Title
sections.description: The 2026 manual text shown contains no information about salvage titles, total loss vehicle declarations, or insurance-related vehicle loss procedures.
bullets: "If your vehicle becomes inoperable due to fire, vandalism, collision, theft, flood, or another event to such an extent that you or, if insured, your insurer considers it uneconomical to repair the vehicle, the vehicle will be declared a total loss." (2003 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
